title: Google signs long-term special rate contract with Entergy Arkansas

sources.quote: Special Rate Contract and Arkansas Cypress Solar In September 2025, Entergy Arkansas filed an application with the APSC seeking approval of a long-term special rate contract between Altitude, LLC, a subsidiary of Alphabet, Inc. (Google) and Entergy Arkansas for the sale of electricity to a new large-scale data center in West Memphis, Arkansas.

In December 2025 the APSC issued an order approving the special rate contract but denying the requested ratemaking treatment of Google’s upfront payments and deferring a decision on the treatment under the contract pricing providing for the deferral and amortization of the investment tax credits from the Arkansas Cypress Solar facility (discussed below).

explain: Google (through its subsidiary Altitude, LLC) signed a long-term contract to buy electricity from Entergy Arkansas for a new data center in West Memphis, including upfront payments and power from a new Arkansas Cypress Solar plant; regulators approved it in December 2025. Value not disclosed. Entergy filed it in September 2025; the date here is when Entergy first reported it in a filing. Plant: Arkansas Cypress Solar (planned), plus Entergy Arkansas system power.
